title: Compatibility of the actual affine-spectrum stalk ring maps
statement: For a cartesian square of affine schemes [def-pc-scheme] and a cartesian square of their spectra of global sections, let z0 be a point of Spec Γ(X', top), z=X'.isoSpec.inv(z0), and R,A,B,D and R0,A0,B0,D0 the stalk rings with their structural maps [def-pc-single-complex-base-change-stalk-condition]. Define canonicalSpectrumStalkEquiv(Y,y,y0,h) by the ring isomorphism eqToIso(congrArg Y.presheaf.stalk h) followed by the stalk isomorphism of Y.isoSpec.inv, where h:y=Y.isoSpec.inv(y0). Fix eA to this map for Y=X, y=g'(z), y0=g0'(z0), h from isoSpec naturality, and fix eD to this map for Y=X', y=z, y0=z0, h=rfl. There exist eR:R≃+*R0 and eB:B≃+*B0 such that eA(algebraMap R A r)=algebraMap R0 A0 (eR r), eB(algebraMap R B r)=algebraMap R0 B0 (eR r), and eD(μ(a tensor b))=μ0(eA(a) tensor eB(b)) for every r,a,b. This assertion fixes eA and eD to the actual stalk maps and does not involve complexes or q.

proof.text: Construct eR and eB by the stalk isomorphisms of the isoSpec inverses after transporting their source points. Naturality of isoSpec, stalkMap_comp and stalkMap_congr_hom prove the two base-ring equations.

The restriction equations of tensorMap express a pure tensor image as the product of the two projection stalk images. Apply naturality of both projection stalk maps and preservation of multiplication by eD.

theorem exists_canonicalSpectrum_stalk_ring_coordinates
    {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (g : S' ⟶ S) (g' : X' ⟶ X)
    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    [IsAffine X] [IsAffine X'] [IsAffine S] [IsAffine S']
    (sq0 : IsPullback (Spec.map g'.appTop) (Spec.map f'.appTop)
      (Spec.map f.appTop) (Spec.map g.appTop))
    (z0 : Spec Γ(X', ⊤)) :
    let z := X'.isoSpec.inv z0
    letI := leftAlgebra f g' z
    letI := rightAlgebra f f' g g' sq z
    letI := (tensorMap f f' g g' sq z).toAlgebra
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (ModuleCat.{u} (R f g' z))
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (ModuleCat.{u} (B f' z))
    letI := leftAlgebra (Spec.map f.appTop) (Spec.map g'.appTop) z0
    letI := rightAlgebra (Spec.map f.appTop) (Spec.map f'.appTop)
      (Spec.map g.appTop) (Spec.map g'.appTop) sq0 z0
    letI := (tensorMap (Spec.map f.appTop) (Spec.map f'.appTop)
      (Spec.map g.appTop) (Spec.map g'.appTop) sq0 z0).toAlgebra
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard
      (ModuleCat.{u} (R (Spec.map f.appTop) (Spec.map g'.appTop) z0))
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (ModuleCat.{u} (B (Spec.map f'.appTop) z0))
    let R0 := R (Spec.map f.appTop) (Spec.map g'.appTop) z0
    let A0 := A (Spec.map g'.appTop) z0
    let B0 := B (Spec.map f'.appTop) z0
    let D0 := C z0
    let hA : g' z = X.isoSpec.inv ((Spec.map g'.appTop) z0) :=
      (congrArg (fun k : Spec Γ(X', ⊤) ⟶ X ↦ k z0)
        (Scheme.isoSpec_inv_naturality g')).symm
    let eA := canonicalSpectrumStalkEquiv X (g' z) ((Spec.map g'.appTop) z0) hA
    let eD := canonicalSpectrumStalkEquiv X' z z0 rfl
    ∃ (eR : R f g' z ≃+* R0) (eB : B f' z ≃+* B0),
      (∀ r : R f g' z,
        eA (algebraMap (R f g' z) (A g' z) r) = algebraMap R0 A0 (eR r)) ∧
      (∀ r : R f g' z,
        eB (algebraMap (R f g' z) (B f' z) r) = algebraMap R0 B0 (eR r)) ∧
      (∀ (a : A g' z) (b : B f' z),
        eD (algebraMap (A g' z ⊗[R f g' z] B f' z) (C z) (a ⊗ₜ[R f g' z] b)) =
          algebraMap (A0 ⊗[R0] B0) D0 (eA a ⊗ₜ[R0] eB b))
